我们为什么要做这件事

Why We Do This

📚

AI 时代的能力缺口

Competency Gap in the AI Era

大量孩子仍停留在机械刷题模式，缺少独立思考、实地调研和解决真实问题的能力——这些恰恰是 AI 无法替代的核心竞争力。

Many children remain stuck in rote-learning mode, lacking independent thinking, field research, and real-world problem-solving skills—the very core competencies that AI cannot replace.

🎒

双减后的落地难题

Implementation Gap After "Double Reduction"

新课标推行跨学科实践，但市面缺少标准化、可落地的家庭/校园 PBL 工具，多数研学停留在观光打卡。

The new curriculum promotes interdisciplinary practice, yet standardized, actionable PBL tools for families and schools are scarce. Most study tours remain superficial sightseeing.

🌍

全球文化的传播断层

Cultural Communication Disconnect

国内非遗与城市文化缺少青少年对外传播渠道，海外优质实践资源也难以走进国内家庭。

China's intangible heritage and urban culture lack youth-driven global channels, while overseas quality resources struggle to reach Chinese families.

三大核心板块

Three Core Modules

🌍

创世地球

My Earth

选择文明角色，在3D地球上开拓属于自己的领地。从远古聚落到未来联盟，通过PBL探索理解人类历史演变，在战争思辨中锻炼批判性思维。

Choose a civilization character and develop your own territory on a 3D Earth. From ancient settlements to future alliances, understand human history through PBL exploration and develop critical thinking through war reflection.

开始创造 → Start Creating →

分龄 PBL 项目库

Age-Appropriate PBL Library

按年龄段、主题和难度提供城市文化、非遗传承、社区观察、未来城市等项目，家长和老师可直接取用。

Projects organized by age, theme, and difficulty—covering urban culture, intangible heritage, community observation, and future cities. Ready-to-use for parents and teachers.

浏览项目 → Browse Projects →

跨国文化交流社区

Cross-Cultural Exchange Community

海内外青少年分享城市项目成果，进行线上交流与共创。国内孩子传播非遗文化，海外孩子分享地域文明。

Youth worldwide share city project outcomes, engage in online exchange and co-creation. Chinese children spread intangible heritage; overseas children share regional civilizations.

Target Users & Scenarios

Collaborate online across borders on city-themed projects, share local history and culture, and complete cross-cultural practice assignments.

Comprehensive practice courses, interdisciplinary projects, after-school services, and school-based curriculum preparation—reducing prep costs while deepening inquiry.

价值与意义

Value & Impact

💼 商业价值

💼 Business Value

  • 依托素质教育改革风口，打造差异化线上 PBL 工具
  • Ride the wave of quality education reform to build differentiated online PBL tools
  • 独家原创共创城市项目、跨国文化联动课程形成付费内容资产
  • Exclusive original city co-creation projects and cross-cultural courses become premium content assets
  • 构建"线上课程引流 + 线下研学转化 + 跨国共创营"商业闭环
  • Build a closed-loop business model: online courses → offline study tours → global co-creation camps

❤️ 社会价值

❤️ Social Impact

  • 响应双减、新课标项目式学习政策，跳出机械刷题模式
  • Respond to "Double Reduction" and new curriculum PBL policies, moving beyond rote learning
  • 搭建全球青少年文化互通桥梁，培养全球视野与文化包容力
  • Build bridges for global youth cultural exchange, fostering global perspective and cultural inclusivity
  • 网页无设备、地域门槛，普通家庭、乡村学校均可免费使用基础内容
  • Zero device or location barriers—ordinary families and rural schools can access basic content for free
